name: etbaaly-mcp-server
title: إطبعلي | Etbaaly MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Etbaaly printing, packaging boxes manufacturing, merchandise customization, and order tracking in Egypt & MENA region.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Retrieve catalog of packaging boxes, custom stickers, corporate gifts, and apparel.

category.description: Category slug (e.g., packaging-boxes, stickers, apparel, corporate-stationery, or all).

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Track custom printing and packaging manufacturing status in real time by order or tracking number.

trackingCode.description: Tracking number or order identifier (e.g. ETB-12345).

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Submit a quotation request for custom carton manufacturing, offset printing, or bespoke branded boxes.

tools.name: get_shipping_rates
tools.description: Calculate domestic shipping rates and delivery estimates across Egyptian governorates.
